original_interpretation: As of Apr 2026 Commerce had disbursed US$13.1bn, ~42% of US$31.2bn direct awards.

original_interpretation: Wolfspeed 48D refunds received (US$186.5m FY25 + US$698.6m Dec 2025 = ~US$885m) exceed its never-finalised US$750m CHIPS award.
evidence_found: "received $698.6 million in cash tax refunds"; "In fiscal 2025, the Company received $186.5 million in cash tax refunds related to its fiscal 2023 and fiscal 2024 federal tax filings." (Wolfspeed, 1 Dec 2025). CRS Table A-2 (PMTs without final award as of 10 Jun 2026): "Wolfspeed October 15, 2024 750".
notes: 186.5 + 698.6 = 885.1 > 750. The US$750m was the PMT ceiling ('up to'), not a signed award.

original_interpretation: Motley Fool: Wolfspeed shares fell nearly in half on 28 Mar 2025 on rumours it would not get the US$750m CHIPS funding.
evidence_found: "the very next day, Wolfspeed's stock plunged nearly in half, accounting for pretty much the entire month's losses ... That morning, rumors began circulating that the company would not receive the $750 million in CHIPS Act funding that the government had agreed to pay Wolfspeed during the prior administration." (Motley Fool, 7 Apr 2025)
notes: 'Next day' follows the 27 Mar CEO announcement, i.e. 28 Mar 2025 (also stated in the article).
